title: Six vertex formalization
main_result: GFF convergence for the balanced plane law, 0 < c <= 2
audit_status: First pass complete; independent analytic verification open

phases.title: Original OAI sources
phases.detail: 93-page original PDF and every manuscript source file, pinned to the OAI dump revision and checked against Git blob hashes.
phases.evidence: 19 source and catalogue files hash-matched. One six-vertex manuscript directory found in the complete preprints directory tree.
phases.next: Preserve the snapshot; record any future upstream revision separately.

phases.title: Finite model and local heights
phases.detail: Ice-rule combinatorics, arrow reversal, periodic-column conservation and local height consistency.
phases.evidence: Finite.lean and Height.lean compile. Local four-face height existence and uniqueness are proved with the physical sign convention.
phases.next: Extend local integration to global simply connected domains. Keep torus winding periods separate.

phases.title: Finite probability and transfer
phases.detail: Duplicate-free finite columns, exact symbolic transfer support and degree bounds, plus a normalized positive-rational single-column probability law.
phases.evidence: Enumeration.lean proves no repeated configurations; erasing the seam spin remains injective at positive height. Weights.lean proves exact rational transfer evaluation, positivity and normalization. Build and all-theorem axiom audit pass.
phases.next: Introduce real coefficients; construct the multi-column finite torus law and prove its transfer trace identity. Then prove the local matrix identities.

phases.title: Roots and thermodynamic bounds
phases.detail: Real Bethe roots, uniform Gaudin and mixed bounds, harmonic row normalization and simultaneous determinant tails.
phases.evidence: Proofs located in Sections 2–3. No analytic lemma from these sections has been formalized.
phases.next: Audit the sparse-edge maximum-principle argument and common uniform constants; state the needed function spaces precisely.

phases.title: Plane law and angular spectrum
phases.detail: Hilbert-space construction, common-radius boundary continuation, physical-law identification and current measure.
phases.evidence: Proofs located in Section 4. External plane-law/strict-convexity statements were checked against the cited papers.
phases.next: Verify the finite folded-block identities and both quotient bounds before constructing the infinite representation.

phases.title: Chiral currents and Wick rule
phases.detail: Two-scale spectral convergence, control of all zeros, damped current limits and nonvacuum collision estimates.
phases.evidence: The manuscript includes dedicated all-zero and collision arguments. Their full implications remain independently unverified.
phases.next: Prove spectral truncation and the collision limit. Covariance calculations alone do not establish this milestone.

phases.title: Exact variance multiplier
phases.detail: For c<1: stiffness and twist-overlap comparison. For 1<=c<2: conditional normalization after a GFF subsequential limit is proved.
phases.evidence: Section 5 has a deferred overlap proof. DKLM Theorems 4.3–4.4 support the stated conditional use in their parameter range.
phases.next: Check finite twist jets and determinant asymptotics, preserving every order of limits. Retain Gaussian convergence as an assumption in the conditional branch.

phases.title: Height-field convergence
phases.detail: Smooth tests, desmoothing, finite-energy measures and tightness in explicitly defined negative-regularity spaces.
phases.evidence: Section 7 provides separate arguments for restriction spaces, the outward completion and intrinsic duals. None is yet formalized.
phases.next: Start with joint convergence on smooth neutral tests; fix the topology before extending the statement.

phases.title: Separate endpoint c = 2
phases.detail: Independent fair-signed FK loop route, homotopy coupling and external endpoint GFF argument, plus the additional topology implication.
phases.evidence: The loop-bijection and infinite-volume correspondence cited by the appendix were located in the external sources. The full extraction remains open.
phases.next: Prove the exact coupling statement with multiplicities and homogeneous marginals, followed by sign-averaged uniform integrability.

phases.title: Full balanced six-vertex theorem
phases.detail: Assemble the prescribed balanced-torus plane law, all parameter branches, variance normalization and each promised mode of convergence.
phases.evidence: No main-result proof in this project. Finite helper-theorem counts do not measure overall completion.
phases.next: Close the analytic dependencies and check that the final Lean statement matches the pinned manuscript exactly.
